source.title: Two open problems related to the lambda-property

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. Shell fetching failed with network_or_dns_failure: curl could not resolve host zbmath.org. Direct web opening of https://zbmath.org/1561029 did not return readable record content. Local project resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identified the same URL as a 2000 source titled Two open problems related to the lambda-property, with no full-text links.

Bounded recovery searched the exact title, title variants with lambda and Greek lambda, the zbMATH identifier, and likely Banach-space lambda-property phrasing. Candidate pages were either unrelated works, metadata-only zbMATH author/profile pages, abstracts, paywalled publisher pages, or different articles such as Rotundity, the C.S.R.P., and the lambda-property in Banach spaces and Mazur Intersection Properties and Differentiability of Convex Functions in Banach Spaces. No readable PDF or full HTML source containing the exact source's problem statements could be verified.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1561029.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
